conversion.scope: capsuleCollision.js and colliderBuild.js only; cameraRaycast.js is an explicit adapted extraction described in cameraRaycast.

smoke.scope: CPU geometry/collision compatibility of these exact two source leaves; no browser/WebGL or full controller smoke performed.

limitations.bareNodeImport: three-mesh-bvh 0.7.8 has main=build/index.umd.cjs and module=src/index.js; bare Node ESM loads the CJS entry and both Three CJS/ESM class identities. The browser module resolver selects the ESM entry and one Three build. Geometry checks pass in both; bare Node identity check fails as preserved in bare-node-results.json.
limitations.npmDeprecation: three-mesh-bvh@0.7.8 is marked Deprecated due to three.js version incompatibility. Please use v0.8.0, instead. No version was substituted; only the exact Three161/BVH078 leaves were smoke tested.
solverRequirements: Separate unit-scale upright capsule proxy; segment.start=(0,0,0); proxy has no transformed parent.
Bake source geometry transforms and keep output collider scale=1.
Refresh proxy and collider matrixWorld before each query.
Valid non-overlapping initial pose and bounded steps; zero-distance/deep existing overlap is not guaranteed to resolve.
Position correction only: integration adapter remains responsible for inward velocity, bounds and state gating.

cameraRaycast.adaptation: Extracted closest-hit loop; ctrl/vehicle filtering replaced by explicit active mesh list. New five-ray clearance and view reframing are local CameraAvoidance, not the original updateWithRaycast or full CameraSystem.
